# Profile maintenance

Edit `README.md` directly. The profile uses GitHub-native Markdown and HTML; it does not depend on a generator, third-party stats images, or scheduled workflows.

The banners in `assets/` have desktop and mobile layouts, each in light and dark colors. Keep their text in sync. The `<picture>` element selects the banner for the viewer's screen width and color preference; the desktop light version is the fallback.

The body is a short Chinese introduction and a compact project list. Use plain descriptions; avoid slogans, invented personal anecdotes, emoji section headings, and repeated feature tags. Project descriptions come from the public TravelPlanner and MediaMind READMEs and the skills-hub interface. No employment history, contact address, or personal credentials are assumed.

To change featured projects, edit the project links and short descriptions together. To change the greeting or tagline, update all four SVGs and the image alt text.

The previous README generator and unused contribution-snake workflow were removed so the profile stays manually curated. Existing Git history retains the previous version.
